Boundaries.Name: script-correction-borrower
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the correction caller's observation through script fallback and mutation cleanup. Never publish a producer final error or dispose an independent caller's owner.

Boundaries.Name: cursor-page-conversion
Boundaries.Contract: A supplied observation borrows the page's owner started before construction; otherwise conversion starts its own owner. Replica cursor affinity, retries, conversion and reply cleanup stay inside that one owner.
